zh.title: 阿聯酋航空A380深夜備降乘客滯留10小時無空調
zh.summary: 根據Simple Flying報導，阿聯酋航空一架A380客機因故深夜備降，乘客在機艙內滯留超過十小時，期間空調失效，最終乘客抵達上海。
body: 根據Simple Flying的報導，阿聯酋航空的一架A380客機在深夜因故備降，導致乘客在機艙內滯留超過十小時，期間空調失效。備降發生在深夜，飛機在地面上停靠，乘客忍受著沒有冷卻的環境。
乘客整夜留在機艙坡道上，最終抵達上海。報導指出，該航班載有373名乘客，他們在非計劃停靠期間長時間沒有機艙空調。
該報導於2026年7月28日由Simple Flying發布，網址為https://simpleflying.com/373-passengers-stranded-10-hours-emirates-a380-diversion/。來源未提供其他額外細節。

en.title: Emirates A380 Diverts Overnight, Passengers Stranded Over 10 Hours Without Air Conditioning
en.summary: According to Simple Flying, an Emirates A380 aircraft experienced a late-night diversion, resulting in passengers being stranded on board for over ten hours without air conditioning. The diversion occurred late at night, and the aircraft remained on the ground while passengers endured the lack of cooling. Passengers stayed on the aircraft on the ramp throughout the night and eventually reached Shanghai after the incident was resolved.
body: According to Simple Flying, an Emirates A380 aircraft experienced a late-night diversion, resulting in passengers being stranded on board for over ten hours without air conditioning. The diversion occurred late at night, and the aircraft remained on the ground while passengers endured the lack of cooling.

Passengers stayed on the aircraft on the ramp throughout the night and eventually reached Shanghai after the incident was resolved. The report notes that the flight carried 373 passengers who were affected by the prolonged lack of cabin air conditioning during the unscheduled stop.

The original article was published by Simple Flying on July 28, 2026, and can be viewed at https://simpleflying.com/373-passengers-stranded-10-hours-emirates-a380-diversion/. No further details were provided in the source material.
